prompts.neutral:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: full-body transparent anime chibi mascot artwork designed for subtle cutout-puppet animation on a website.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and exact character identity reference. Preserve her silver-white / pale-lavender hair, dark-violet crystal bow on the viewer's left, pink-violet DNA hair ornament, dark cat hair clip on the viewer's right, white lab coat with cat emblem, dark dress, cat badge, violet shoes and polished delicate illustration style. Preserve the two-head-tall cute Q-version proportions.
Change the pose so real local animations can be made:
1. Face nearly front-on, BOTH large violet eyes open and smiling, mouth cheerful and small. No wink in this neutral frame.
2. Her arm on the viewer's RIGHT reaches outward to the right, bent at the elbow with a small open palm raised in a friendly wave BESIDE her head. The whole waving hand and forearm must be OUTSIDE the hair and face silhouette, clearly outlined against transparency, not overlapping hair or face. Keep a small transparent gap between hand and hair. The coat shoulder stays attached naturally; elbow, sleeve, wrist and hand must form one clear continuous arm. Exactly five small simple fingers.
3. Her other hand on the viewer's LEFT holds the small dark tablet with a lavender protein-ribbon icon at waist level. Put a tiny capped specimen tube in the coat pocket instead of a hand-held pipette.
4. A long silver side ponytail attached under the bow on the viewer's LEFT curls down and fans slightly out to the far left below the head. The lower flowing locks must form an easy-to-read separate silhouette outside the torso, away from the waving arm on the opposite side. Keep delicate lavender strands and coherent hair structure.
5. Two short legs stand naturally, feet apart. No crossed limbs. The body and feet should feel still and balanced.
Composition: square canvas, one complete full-body character centered, narrow transparent margins, entire bow, wave hand, ponytail tips and both shoes inside the frame. The silhouette should fill about 90% of canvas height. Keep head and body extremely cute and compact, no elongated torso or legs. The wave can widen her silhouette a little but never crop the fingers.
Background: actual transparent alpha, no scene, no effects, no sparkles, no floating diagrams, no text, logos or watermark. This is ONE cohesive finished character, not a sprite sheet or a parts sheet. Retain the input's premium crisp linework and soft pastel shading. No new characters.

prompts.body:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: an animation CLEAN PLATE / static body layer for a layered chibi puppet. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and must keep exactly the same square canvas, character scale, pixel registration and illustration style.
Create the static layer by removing ONLY these two regions:
A. Remove the raised waving HAND, dark fingerless glove and the small exposed wrist on the viewer's RIGHT. Keep the entire white coat sleeve and purple cuff unchanged, including its opening. Reconstruct any silver hair that was hidden behind the thumb/wrist, and leave actual transparency where the removed fingers were outside the hair silhouette. This hand will be supplied later as a separate moving layer; do not replace it with another hand.
B. Remove the long flowing rear SIDE PONYTAIL on the viewer's LEFT, below and behind the dark bow. Keep the dark bow, its ribbons and the entire front hair/head silhouette unchanged. Remove only the long silver locks outside the left of the body and tablet, particularly the hanging curls that reach down near her knees; use actual transparency in this region. Preserve front cheek locks, the hair right next to the face, and body/tablet edges.
Do not move or alter ANY other part: both eyes remain OPEN, face and smile identical, head shape, DNA hair ornament, cat clip, bow, lab coat, tablet and holding hand, both legs and shoes. The result is intentionally a partial puppet layer, not a complete character. Do not invent substitute limbs or a shorter ponytail. Keep all original dimensions and exact alignment to Image 1 so the original hand and ponytail can be composited back seamlessly. No text, effects, shadows or background. Real transparent alpha.

alphaValidation: All five generated PNG alpha channels match their WebP alpha channels pixel for pixel. Original dimensions preserved; no bitmap painting or removal was performed during WebP conversion.

animation.body: Static; no full-picture float or breathing transform
animation.hand: Independent wrist rotation -7 to 9 degrees with pauses, 5.2-second loop
animation.hair: Independent rear ponytail sway -1.1 to 1.2 degrees, 5.6-second loop
animation.blink: Locally masked closed-eye artwork, brief double blink in a 6.8-second loop
animation.fallback: Complete neutral frame remains visible until all rig layers load and decode; failure retains the complete neutral frame.

centering.basis: Maximum horizontal alpha envelope across each animated part's motion, alpha threshold > 16
centering.layout: max-content title, centered flexible middle track, responsive fixed-width profile card; equal 24px grid gaps
